name: Stack
purpose: Plain flex wrapper with no fill of its own. Groups the inspector body, capture bar rows and drag strips.

values.when: Horizontal flex: capture title row and footer row.
Vertical flex: inspector body root and the lightbox stage.
Capture bar footer row (justify-between, gap-2, px-3, py-2).
flex-1 min-w-0 for the task area; min-h-0 added for column bodies. Replaces B's grow boolean.

props.name: dragRegion
props.description: Desktop only: marks the element as a window drag region (data-tauri-drag-region). A treats this as a prop because it is behaviour, not a look; B's drag axis is folded here.

props.name: motion
props.description: Entrance animation (animate-rise) for the inspector body.

platform: Same. dragRegion is desktop only; on web the same element is a spacer. The capture rows are desktop only.
open: animate-rise (motion) needs a motion token not defined in the catalogue. Gap and padding values are token names with no px in the source; resolve when mapping tokens. Not Stack (listed as notWidgets or other widgets): tab strip drag filler, search options wrapper, toolbar group wrapper (Toolbar), lightbox stage and lightbox media wrapper (Lightbox). Capture footer keeps its px-3 py-2 padding here rather than Footer row, because its padding differs (B folded it into Footer). Capture footer drag: B's Footer drag claim conflicts with A (only the title row drags); unverified, so dragRegion stays on the title row.
